video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — an East Asian woman about 33 years old with light skin and a straight black shoulder-length bob, wearing a plain beige cardigan over a black top and dark trousers — sits alone, sitting on the front edge of an armchair in a calm home office with a bookshelf full of books, a wooden desk with a closed laptop and a desk lamp, soft afternoon light, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same seat, same distance from the camera. Handheld-steady phone on a tripod, the camera stays still; the room around her stays still. She talks straight into the camera, serious and caring, like warning a friend, with small natural head movements; her hands stay clasped near her knees with small gestures.
